usageNotes: Returns all ACME challenge plugin configurations registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including both standalone HTTP and DNS-01 challenge plugins. Requires the caller to hold the System.Modify privilege on the system/certificates path — a read-only privilege is not sufficient. Use this before creating or updating ACME orders to confirm the desired plugin ID exists and is not disabled.

examples.summary: List all configured ACME challenge plugins

tips: Items with 'disable: true' are present in the list but will not be used by ACME certificate orders — check this field before referencing a plugin ID in a certificate configuration.
The 'validation-delay' field (in seconds) is relevant for DNS-01 plugins where the DNS provider has a long TTL; increase it if ACME validation fails intermittently.
The 'plugin' field is the ID you reference when assigning a challenge plugin to a node's ACME certificate configuration.
